There is any solution to export a sound without amplitude normalization or amplification?

Thanks you for your future help.

Mélanie AZNAR

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] install seewave on Mac
messages.body_plain:
It worked here Jerome, but previous to brew installing I had to install home brew...

My seeave working fine now on latest OS.

Thanks!

Carlos.

On Thursday, May 18, 2017 at 6:56:12 AM UTC-3, Jérôme SUEUR wrote:
> Gianni, it seems you miss the fftw C library
>
> Try this in your terminal
>
> brew install fftw
>
> and may be as well
>
> brew install lbsndfile
>
> HTH
>
> Jerome

> OS X El Capitan binaries: r-release: not available
> OS X Mavericks binaries: r-oldrel: seewave_2.0.5.tgz <https://cran.r-project.org/bin/macosx/mavericks/contrib/3.3/seewave_2.0.5.tgz>
>
> Thus it appears that compiling is required on Mac OS .... but when compiling the <fftw3.h> file is missing.....
>
> Just today I have 4 hours lecture and exercitation on sound analysis on Mac .... I'll switch to PC !
>
> Gianni
>
